risk_statement: If data-use approval is delayed, the validated extract may miss the analysis start date
trigger: Approval not complete by end of Week 3
response_actions: Begin approval during initiation; review twice weekly
contingency: Move non-data drafting forward and escalate to sponsor

risk_statement: If comparison records have limited overlap, the planned ATT estimate may not represent all participants
response_actions: Review overlap before outcomes; prespecify trimming and alternate estimands
contingency: Narrow the target population and document the change

risk_statement: If delivery varies substantially across sites, an overall estimate may conceal decision-relevant differences
trigger: Implementation measure outside tolerance at three or more sites
response_actions: Validate fidelity measures and plan descriptive heterogeneity analysis
contingency: Frame findings by implementation condition without underpowered causal subgroup claims

risk_statement: If stakeholder review exceeds five business days, sponsor approval may miss budget planning
trigger: No consolidated feedback by review deadline
response_actions: Schedule review windows now; require one consolidated response
contingency: Escalate unresolved conflicts to sponsor decision
